name: mcp_search_tools
description: Read the definitions of MCP server tools, or search them by keyword. The tools are listed by name in the system prompt, but their input schemas are not loaded: read a tool's definition here before running it with mcp_call_tool.

names.description: Full names of the tools to read, as listed.

query.description: Keywords for what you want to do; matched against tool names and full descriptions.

detail.description: How much to return for each tool: the name, the name with its full description, or the full definition with its input schema. Defaults to schemas when names are given, descriptions otherwise.

name: mcp_call_tool
description: Run an MCP server tool. Read its definition with mcp_search_tools first, then pass arguments that match its input schema.

name.description: The tool's full name, as listed.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the tool's input schema.
